Exampleton Station Precinct Rezoning

This page is fictional and exists only for software tests.

The Exampleton Station precinct core allows buildings up to 12 storeys within 200 metres of the station. The surrounding walkable catchment allows townhouses and apartments up to 4 storeys.

The rezoning is expected to support 4,500 additional homes by 2045. Community consultation ran for six weeks and received 812 submissions.

A new bus interchange will open next to Exampleton Station, with services every 10 minutes during peak periods.
